content.comment_body: Hello! Is anyone familiar with performing a clean installation on a MacBook? The older installation CD for [product_name] version [version_no] does not allow installation. I hope it's not necessary to purchase another license. Any suggestions?

Hello [user_name], I suggest verifying if your operating system matches one of those listed as compatible in the manual (see page 25): [document]. Here's a link to download the demo to see if installation is possible since you mentioned you have a license: [url] Could you provide a screenshot of the error? That would help us assist you.
You cannot upgrade a demo to a fully licensed version. The license applies only to the full version.
Thank you for your response. It's still unclear if I am able to use the old [version_no] license CD for the newly downloaded software, and how that process works.
Refer to this [company_name] FAQ for instructions on installing an upgrade for [product_name]—both with and without previously installed software.
Proceed without a prior installation because the older CD setup does not function on newer MacBooks.
If you don't get more answers in this thread, consider submitting a support request.
You do not need the old version installed. Begin installation of the downloaded upgrade and insert your previous version CD into the drive when prompted.
Thank you, I will try that solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience challenges when installing an older licensed version of [product_name] ([version_no]) on newer MacBooks, as installation via the original CD no longer works. There is uncertainty about whether an existing license can activate the most recent downloadable software, and the installation and licensing process is unclear. These limitations result in users seeking help from the community or support resources due to insufficient licensing migration guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to perform a fresh installation of the latest compatible version of [product_name] on a MacBook, using an existing [version_no] license, and does not expect to purchase another license.
